name: Size / Projected Distinguishing Range
details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: A projection has at most $|\mathcal H|$ distinct concepts. For any m distinct binary vectors, repeatedly add a coordinate separating two vectors still in the same trace block; each added coordinate increases the number of trace blocks, so at most m-1 coordinates distinguish all m vectors. Apply this to every projection and maximize.
witness_verification: For the n-dimensional full cube, $|\mathcal H|=2^n$ while $\mathrm R^p=n$. Hence the gap is unbounded.
